concepts.definition: The force that draws one person to another.
Interpreting arousal from one source as attraction to a person.

questions.q: What did Montoya and colleagues (2008) find about similarity?
questions.a: Actual similarity predicted attraction in non-interactive settings, perceived similarity in real interaction.

questions.q: What did the speed-dating study of Eastwick and Finkel (2008) show?
questions.a: Stated preferences before meeting did not predict attraction after meeting.
